text:
elaine: Quick sync — kicking off cloud marketplace onboarding for the pilot vendor. Need a small checklist: legal term approval, AMI/VM image mapping, trial SKU entitlements, branding assets, and telemetry hooks. Planning to cut assets next Tue. Who owns what?

jordan: I can take AMI mapping + test images for AWS and Azure. Will need test accounts.

sam_legal: I’ll review the marketplace T&Cs and the trial entitlement language. ETA EOD Thursday. Any special compliance requirements?

devon_product: Will own SKU packaging and trial UX flow. Need confirmation on trial duration (14d vs 30d) and whether seats are per-user or per-tenant.

elaine: Let's go 14d for pilot, per-tenant. We want low friction.

ryan_aws: @jordan I can provision an AWS test org and share creds in 1Password. Also have to confirm AMI signing / hardened image checklist.

nirav_gcp: I’ll handle GCP image family naming + the marketplace listing manifest for GCP. Will need product short description and pricing band.

anika_design: Sending branding pack: logo (svg/png), hero screenshot, short blurb. Anything else for the store tile? maybe a 1-min demo gif.

jordan: Thanks @ryan_aws — can you include a minimal cloud-init snippet we can bake into images? Example we want: ```#cloud-config
users:
  - name: redwood
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL```

sam_legal: FYI, marketplace legal will want a liability limit clause and data processing addendum link. I’ll draft language and put it in the shared drive.

devon_product: For telemetry, we only need anonymous usage pings (no PII). @ops-bot can we add a filter to redact env vars?

ops-bot: action: creating ticket INF-742 for telemetry filter + telemetry docs. Assigned to eng-infra.

elaine: Great. Ownership summary: Jordan -> AMI/VMs, Nirav -> GCP manifest, Devon -> SKU + trial UX, Sam -> legal copy, Anika -> creative assets. Anyone want to swap?

ryan_aws: Fine with that. I’ll post the test account details once ready.

jordan: Starting image bake tomorrow morning. I’ll include cloud-init above and a bootstrap script.

sam_legal: Draft uploaded: /drive/partnerships/marketplace-legal-draft-v1.docx. Please review by Thurs EOD.

devon_product: I’ll prepare the packaging JSON we need to submit. Example fields: {"name":"Redwood Inference (pilot)","sku":"pilot-1","trial_days":14} — will iterate.

anika_design: Uploading hero_gif.mp4 and logo_pack.zip now.

elaine: Thanks team. Goal: submit AWS/GCP/Azure manifests by next Friday. Quick check-in Wed 10am. If blockers come up, drop them here. :thumbsup:
